rules_note: Separate customer referral programme (support article 46046640789787, 22 Sept 2026): referrer $5 in bitcoin + 100 spins once the referred user spends $25 from the Fold balance; referee $10 in bitcoin on a first Fold Debit Card purchase of $25+; the credit card is not a qualifying action. Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: Fold serves US citizens and permanent residents only; affiliate geography not published.
